title: Is AI a Bubble? Wall Street Titans Say Not Even Close
summary: Goldman's Solomon, Morgan Stanley's Pick and Franklin Templeton's Johnson broadly dismissed fears of an AI bubble. Pimco's Roman noted the AI debt wave has not yet distorted broader credit markets.

title: China Plans Broad AI Guardrails After Global Security Lapses
summary: China plans a broad set of standards governing AI safety from development through deployment. They are among the most comprehensive guidelines to guard against loss of control over powerful AI.

title: UBS CEO Ermotti Says Cyber Risks Rival Traditional Bank Threats
summary: UBS CEO Sergio Ermotti warned that cyber attacks now rival or exceed traditional credit and market risks for banks. He argued that managing cyber risk is as important as managing balance-sheet risk.

title: The AI problem we feared is not the AI problem we got
summary: Lay-offs are low by historical standards, but young people may still need help finding a foothold in the labour market. The piece examines AI's effect on entry-level work.

title: Wall Street CEOs, Big Money Managers Divided Over AI Risks
summary: Major asset managers are sounding alarms about risks to the AI boom even as top Wall Street CEOs tout the windfall. The split shows how divided finance leaders are over AI exposure.

title: UBS CEO Says Cyber Risk Controls Are Key for Banks
summary: Ermotti urged regulators and the industry to stop stigmatizing cyberattack victims so banks can build collective resilience. He framed cyber controls as a core risk-management priority for the sector.

title: Morgan Stanley CEO Sees Up to $15T AI Investment Wave
summary: Morgan Stanley CEO Ted Pick suggests AI investment could reach $10–15 trillion over the next decade. He points to major potential productivity gains.

title: Blackstone, Pimco Chiefs Debate the Perils of AI Boom
summary: Blackstone's Jon Gray and Pimco's Emmanuel Roman debated whether global credit markets can absorb the multitrillion-dollar AI spending spree. The discussion took place at the HKMA investment summit.

title: Wall Street Chiefs See Robust Demand for Massive AI Deals
summary: Wall Street chiefs said capital markets will keep underwriting the global AI infrastructure buildout. Morgan Stanley projects cumulative spending could reach $15 trillion over the next decade.

title: State Street CEO Says It’s ‘Hard to See’ AI as a Bubble Yet
summary: State Street CEO Ron O'Hanley said it is 'hard to see' AI as a bubble yet, citing demand that supports the massive investments in the technology.

title: DBS CEO on How Southeast Asia's Biggest Bank Deploys AI
summary: DBS CEO Tan Su Shan discusses the bank's aggressive adoption of AI and how the Binance hack shows the need for tighter cyber hygiene. She also covers wealth flows in Singapore and Hong Kong.

title: México concluye evaluación del GAFI sobre lavado de dinero, pero aún falta conocer su calificación
summary: México concluyó la evaluación del GAFI sobre lavado de dinero, pero aún no se conoce su calificación. El resultado es relevante para el sistema financiero y su regulación.

title: Oracle Is Near $10 Billion Share Sale at 11% Discount
summary: Oracle raised $9.9 billion in a share sale priced at an 11% discount after its stock was hit in a choppy session. The raise comes amid heavy AI infrastructure financing needs.

title: The quest for immortality has become serious business
summary: As entrepreneurs peddle scans and supplements, biotechs are probing the mysteries of ageing. The quest for longevity has become serious business.

title: La IA pesa más que Trump en Wall Street: las elecciones de EU pasan a segundo plano
summary: La inversión en IA pesa más que las elecciones de EU en Wall Street, donde los mercados siguen centrados en el rally tecnológico. Las intermedias pasan a segundo plano para los inversionistas.

title: Restaurantes, bienestar y mascotas ganan espacio en el gasto con tarjetas de jóvenes
summary: Restaurantes, bienestar y mascotas ganan espacio en el gasto con tarjetas de jóvenes en México. Los datos muestran cambios en los hábitos de consumo de las nuevas generaciones.

title: “Queremos salir a la bolsa de EE.UU. y ser el próximo unicornio argentino”, dice el CEO de Laboratorios Richmond
summary: Marcelo Figueiras, presidente de Laboratorios Richmond, busca multiplicar por dos o tres la facturación en cinco años y avanzar hacia una salida a la bolsa de EE.UU. Aspira a ser el próximo unicornio argentino.

title: House Up in the Clouds / Hennessey Architecture
summary: A renovated 1962 Eichler home in San Francisco's Diamond Heights gains a fourth-level addition with family room and bathroom. The project makes the house more functional for a growing family.

title: Hackers are running riot with AI. Its makers want to cash in
summary: OpenAI and Anthropic see a big opportunity in cyber-security as hackers increasingly use AI. The AI makers aim to monetize defensive tools against AI-driven attacks.

title: Deuda de la IA enciende una alerta en el BIS por sus posibles efectos en otros mercados de bonos
summary: El BIS advirtió que el creciente financiamiento de infraestructura de IA mediante deuda podría elevar riesgos para la estabilidad financiera. Señala posibles presiones sobre otros mercados de bonos.
